title: A Recognition Method of Soybean Leaf Diseases Based on an Improved Deep Learning Model.
summary: An attention-based residual network classifies three soybean leaf diseases on field images; held-out recognition and speed comparisons are reported against ResNet18. Claim is limited to image-based disease recognition, not field-level yield or treatment benefit.
ai_technology: Residual attention network identifies disease categories from soybean leaf images.
